executive_summary.headline: The social signal is a move from chat to delegation and review.
executive_summary.body: Professional and creator-platform coverage keeps surfacing identity, shared context, skill marketplaces, and human approval as the interface around agent work.

executive_summary.headline: Consumer demos expose reusable enterprise design principles.
executive_summary.body: Skill distribution, persistent memory, and guided workflows can be tested internally without installing the consumer product on managed devices.

top_picks.title: Enterprise AI needs an interface for review, not just generation
top_picks.author: AI management researcher
top_picks.summary: A widely shared management signal argues that agents need delegation, review, and handoff interfaces, plus identity, least privilege, spend thresholds, and a kill switch.
top_picks.enterprise_translation: Translate the signal into a bounded internal experiment: define the workflow outcome, constrain tool access, make the human handoff explicit, and measure quality, exception rate, latency, and cost before expanding.
